comment: Unique identifier for this AI provider.
Use a descriptive name like 'azure-foundry-prod', 'azure-foundry-dev', etc.
Provider type identifier.
This value is automatically set based on your selection during gather mode.
Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI) service endpoint URL.
Default: https://ai.azure.com/api/v1
Or use your custom Azure OpenAI endpoint
Whether this provider is active.
Set to 'false' to temporarily disable without removing configuration.
Azure API key for authentication.
Azure OpenAI model identifier.
Whether this is the default model for this provider.
Only ONE model per provider should have default=true.
Whether to use Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) for authentication.
Set to 'true' to use Entra ID, 'false' to use API key authentication.
Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
GPT-4: up to 16384, GPT-4-turbo: up to 128000
Sampling temperature (0.0-2.0).
Lower values make output more focused and deterministic.
Higher values make output more creative and random.
Default: 1.0
Request timeout in seconds.
Default: 60
Azure OpenAI API version.
Default: 2024-12-01-preview
Check Azure documentation for latest available versions.
Maximum context window size in tokens.
Common limits: gpt-4: 8192, gpt-4-turbo: 128000, gpt-35-turbo: 16385
